answer: atlas keeps one sponsorship graph; a quill may sign for only one newcomer until its opal matures, and atlas marks that quill, its funder and every prior signer as kin to the principal. Head one needs one unrelated quill locking 1 opal. Head k needs 2^(k-1) quills whose opal is unlinked to all earlier heads; overlap burns every linked opal. Ten clones need 1,023 independent quill locks: the bill is bribing that many unrelated sponsors.
